macro_rules! warn {
    ($($arg:tt)*) => {};
}

#[tracing::instrument(level = "info")]
pub fn local_lookalike() -> Result<(), String> {
    warn!("a local macro that is not tracing's");
    Ok(())
}

#[tracing::instrument(level = "info")]
pub fn real_event() -> Result<(), String> {
    tracing::warn!("tracing's own");
    Ok(())
}

#[tracing::instrument(level = "info")]
pub fn event_in_closure() -> Result<(), String> {
    Err("failed".to_string()).map_err(|error: String| {
        tracing::error!("{error}");
        error
    })
}
